An '''anti-radiation pill'''<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> or '''radiation-protection drug''' was a treatment to protect individuals against the effects of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]].<ref name="Firestorm">{{JournalCite|15|Firestorm (short story)}}</ref> The pills were part of a [[radiation zone assault trooper]]'s standard survival equipment.<ref name="GG9" />
